# Trust Chain MCP

> Trust chain and attestation management by MEOK AI Labs

`trust-chain-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install trust-chain-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx trust-chain-mcp
```

## Tools

- `create_trust_anchor` — Create a new trust anchor (root of trust) for an entity.
- `verify_chain` — Verify the integrity of a trust chain by validating all attestations.
- `add_attestation` — Add an attestation (claim) to an existing trust anchor.
- `get_trust_score` — Calculate a composite trust score for an anchor based on its attestations.
- `revoke_trust` — Revoke a trust anchor or attestation. This invalidates the chain.
